objective: Deliver Balthule's letter to Delgren the Purifier in Ashenvale Forest.

description: My master, Delgren the Purifier, is a paladin who has graciously offered his assistance in defending our forests from the forces of the demons and undead. He has taught me much about the Holy Light and the art of battle.
Delgren must know of the cult's operations immediately.
You will find him far south of here at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale Forest. Be swift, I fear the Dark Strand's threat grows with each passing hour.
progress: You have some business with me, <class>?
completion: If you don't mind my saying, you seem a bit well-equipped for a messenger, hm? I suppose Balthule wanted to be certain that his letter reached my hands. Let's see what he has to say...
This is disturbing news. When undead or demonic forces are found, I help the Sentinels destroy them.
At first I was unaccustomed to the manners of the night elves, but I have grown to respect them greatly as allies.
